name: wp-studio
description: Build, design, and manage WordPress sites with WordPress Studio: create local sites with Studio's design workflow, open your Studio and WordPress.com sites from the WordPress tab, preview them, and publish to WordPress.com.

interface.longDescription: Build WordPress sites from a conversation: Studio creates the site on your computer, asks about the look and layout with rendered previews, generates the imagery, builds a block theme and checks the result visually. The WordPress tab lists your local Studio sites and your WordPress.com sites, with a page per site to start it, open WP Admin, run speed and SEO audits, or pull a WordPress.com site to work on it locally. Publish to WordPress.com when you are ready. Studio comes with the plugin and updates with it.
defaultPrompt: Build a WordPress site for my bakery

positive.description: Core workflow: build a new local WordPress site from a request. Setup: none; the plugin comes with the WordPress Studio CLI. When Codex shows look and layout options, pick any. Passes when the site runs and shows a bakery home page in the chosen style.
positive.prompt: Build a one-page WordPress site for Crumb & Co, a neighborhood bakery.
positive.tools_triggered: studio_instructions, site_create, pick_design, present_design_options, wp_cli, take_screenshot
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a local site named "Crumb & Co" with site_create, asks the user to choose a look and a layout with present_design_options, builds a block theme and a home page about the bakery, checks it with take_screenshot, and replies with the site URL (http://localhost:<port>) and its WP Admin link. Opening the URL shows the bakery home page in the chosen style.

positive.description: Setup: run the cases in order in one Codex workspace; the first builds the Crumb & Co site the others use. Edit an existing local site: add a page with given content. Passes when the new page is published and shows the hours.
positive.prompt: Add a Contact page to my Crumb & Co site with our hours: Tuesday to Sunday, 7am to 3pm.
positive.tools_triggered: studio_instructions, site_list, site_info, wp_cli, validate_blocks, take_screenshot
positive.expected_behavior: Creates and publishes a Contact page on the existing Crumb & Co site (not a new site), with the hours Tuesday to Sunday, 7am to 3pm, and replies with the page URL. Opening it shows the page with those hours.

positive.description: Setup: run the cases in order in one Codex workspace; the first builds the Crumb & Co site the others use. Read the user's local sites without changing them. Passes when the answer matches the site_list result.
positive.prompt: Which WordPress sites do I have on this computer, and are they running?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists every local Studio site returned by site_list with its name and whether it is running (Crumb & Co appears), without creating, starting, or stopping any site.

positive.description: Setup: run the cases in order in one Codex workspace; the first builds the Crumb & Co site the others use. Performance audit of a local site page. Passes when the reported figures come from the need_for_speed result.
positive.prompt: How fast is the home page of my Crumb & Co site?
positive.expected_behavior: Runs need_for_speed on the Crumb & Co site for the path "/" and reports its Core Web Vitals and performance figures as returned by the tool, with concrete suggestions to improve them.

positive.description: Setup: run the cases in order in one Codex workspace; the first builds the Crumb & Co site the others use. SEO audit of a local site page. Passes when the findings come from the rank_me_up result and the site is left unchanged.
positive.prompt: Check the SEO of my Crumb & Co home page and tell me what to fix.
positive.expected_behavior: Runs rank_me_up on the Crumb & Co site for the path "/" and reports the page title, meta description, and the issues the audit returned, with fixes. It does not change the site unless the user asks.

negative.description: A store on another platform is outside WordPress Studio, which builds WordPress sites. Expected: Codex handles the request without WordPress Studio: it calls no WordPress Studio tool (no site_create) unless the user then asks for a WordPress site, and it never says Studio built the store.
negative.prompt: Build my bakery's online store on Shopify.

negative.description: WordPress Studio cannot register or buy domains. Expected: Codex answers without calling any WordPress Studio tool, and never says WordPress Studio registered the domain.
negative.prompt: Register the domain crumbandco.com for my bakery.

negative.description: WordPress Studio publishes only to WordPress.com, not to other hosts over FTP. Expected: Codex does not run site_push, site_export, wp_cli, or any other WordPress Studio tool unless the user asks for Studio, and never says Studio uploaded the site.
negative.prompt: Upload my Crumb & Co site to my GoDaddy hosting over FTP.

publication.release_notes: First release of WordPress Studio for ChatGPT. Build WordPress sites on your computer from a conversation: Studio asks about the look and the layout, builds a block theme, and checks the result. A WordPress tab lists your local and WordPress.com sites. Edit sites, run speed and SEO audits, and publish to WordPress.com. Studio comes inside the plugin.
